homeView.paper: XDoG: An eXtended difference-of-Gaussians compendium including advanced image stylization
homeView.text5:
(Computers & Graphics, 2012).

It starts by measuring how brightness changes around each pixel with the Sobel operator, and from those gradients builds a smoothed structure tensor, whose eigenvectors describe the local flow of edges in the image. Guided by that flow, it blurs across edges with a difference of Gaussians to find and enhance them, then blurs along edges so the resulting lines come out smooth and coherent.
